verdict.rationale: Warp is an HR/payroll platform, so in-product AI insights are a fair axis. The evidence only shows Warp Agent executing tasks (onboarding, payroll, tax notices) and external MCP agents reaching Warp data. Neither is documented as generating insights or suggestions from the user's data inside the product, so both are adjacent features that earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
